title: release r15: search synonyms + fuzzy recall, title repairs, professional descriptions
head: data-verify-batch-003
body:
## Summary

- Hazard search now expands queries through curated concept synonym groups (配电房→配电室/配电箱, 安全员→安全管理人员, 灭火器失压→没压…), plus a bigram fallback for unsegmented Chinese queries; exact matches still rank first. Fixes the reported "搜配电房什么都搜不到".
- 7 machine-corrupted titles repaired; 4 positive-obligation records returned to rejected (site count 632→628, gate-driven); 106 title-duplicated descriptions rewritten into professional descriptions (per-record, grounded in title/measures/basis).
- strict audit & gate_v4 now classify review-rejected records as excluded (not blockers), matching documented semantics.
- New r15 bundle: 628 hazards / 173 laws / 162 clauses / 806 links, releaseHash f5b02c5f…; verify_unified_bundle OK; node 15 tests, python 20+135, search regression 20/20 all green.
- Remaining quality issues tracked in reports/hazard_review_exception_queue_20260912_glm.md.
